summary.brief: Chef Susie makes homemade marshmallow s’mores from scratch.
summary.detailed: The video shows Chef Susie boiling corn syrup, sugar and water, then adding gelatin dissolved in cold water and mixing it into the hot syrup. She transfers the mixture to a stand mixer and whips it on medium‑high speed until it becomes light, aerated marshmallow. She greases a pan, pours the remaining mixture into it, lets it set at room temperature for about an hour, then cuts the set marshmallows into squares or shapes, dusting them with powdered sugar and cornstarch to reduce stickiness. Using a piping bag, she pipes the fluffy marshmallow onto graham crackers, stacks the crackers to form s’mores, and dips the assembled sandwiches in melted chocolate. Finally she plates the finished s’mores and ends the video with a brief closing segment featuring a man speaking in front of a colorful vegetable graphic.

action.detailed: Whisk the boiled corn‑syrup mixture with dissolved gelatin in a stand mixer until fluffy, pipe the marshmallow onto graham crackers, stack and dip the sandwiches in chocolate, let the remaining mixture set in a greased pan, cut the set marshmallows into pieces, dust them with powdered sugar and cornstarch, and serve.
action.actor: Chef Susie, the female chef wearing a white coat

The video is a cooking tutorial in which a woman in a white chef jacket demonstrates how to whip butter for a sauce.
The video is set in a commercial kitchen, with stainless steel carts and dishwashing equipment behind the woman.  She is surrounded by kitchen utensils, and stands in front of a wooden surface on which she places various cooking items including a bowl, a saucepan, a plate and several small containers.  She leans over this surface towards the camera, and then begins to pick up small items for the demonstration, including a small white bowl that she picks up in her right hand.  She speaks directly to the camera, and then picks up a silicone spatula which she sets down on the saucepan.  She turns, picks up the saucepan, sets it down into a larger stainless bowl and lifts it up in a short arc, as she uses the spatula to scrap off the remaining butter from the pan. She then moves to a grey and black stand mixer, which she holds with her left hand.  She picks up a whisk from the right hand, and begins to run it around the inside of the top of the mixer.  She then pauses, and holds up her right hand to touch her left wrist.  She then continues whisking the butter around, pausing occasionally to turn towards the camera.
There are no annotations.

summary.brief: Chef Susie whips a butter mixture in a stand mixer until it becomes fluffy.
summary.detailed: Chef Susie stands at a wooden countertop surrounded by a clear plastic cup of pale liquid, a red silicone spatula, a small white bowl, a saucepan containing melted butter, and a large stainless‑steel bowl mounted on a grey‑black stand mixer. She lifts the plastic cup to show its contents, then sets it aside and picks up the spatula. Using the spatula she scrapes the remaining butter from the saucepan, lifts the pan and pours the butter into the large bowl beneath the mixer. She attaches a whisk to the stand mixer, runs it on medium‑high speed, briefly pauses to touch her wrist, and continues whisking while occasionally turning toward the camera. The mixture changes from a glossy liquid to a light, aerated foam, completing the whipping process.

action.detailed: Whip the butter mixture in the stand mixer on medium‑high speed until it becomes light and aerated.
action.actor: Chef Susie, the woman in the white chef jacket

nodes.plm_action: Assemble your marshmallow dessert plates.

A woman is seen making cookies in the kitchen. The process is shown step by step. And at the end an image of a man and some food is shown.
The video starts with a woman wearing a chef's outfit. She scoops out a white mixture from a pot with an ice cream scoop and places it on a graham cracker on a plate. She repeats this step for the other two remaining graham crackers.
The next cut shows the white mixture being poured from the pot into a tin.
The next shot shows the graham crackers with the white mixture on them placed on a plate.
As the process is over, the woman begins to stack the graham crackers and white mixture on top of each other and is holding a plate with them on it. At the end there is a final shot of the graham cracker cookies and marshmallows and then the woman in the white chef's outfit. Finally, there is a picture in frame of a man, again wearing a white chefs outfit, and an assortment of colorful vegetables.
The setting of this video is a commercial kitchen with an array of metal racks and appliances, including an oven with a clear glass door. A white wall with a few signs can be seen in the background. The video itself takes place on a wooden table. A small grey rug covers part of the table. The person behind the camera is not visible. A graphic frame with a border of colorful vegetables is seen at the end. The graphics have a thin black border.

summary.brief: Chef Suzie piles marshmallow‑coated graham crackers into s’mores and plates the finished treats.
summary.detailed: In this portion of the tutorial, the female chef in a white coat works at a wooden countertop. She scoops the fluffy white marshmallow mixture from a pot with an ice‑cream‑type scoop (or pipes it from a bag) and spreads it onto individual graham crackers arranged on a plate, repeating the step for each cracker. She then pours the remaining mixture from the pot into a rectangular tin so it can set. After the mixture has set, she stacks the prepared graham crackers together, creating layered s’mores, and arranges the stacked desserts on a serving plate. The camera shows the completed s’mores and marshmallows, and the segment ends with a final frame that displays a male chef beside a colorful vegetable graphic.

summary_sent_to_llm.title: How to Make Marshmallow S'mores
summary_sent_to_llm.description: Learn how to make marshmallow s'mores with Chef Susie from LearnToCook.com. For a complete recipe to accompany this video please visit http://learntocook.com/dessert/how-to-make-marshmallow-smores/
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video shows Chef Susie boiling corn syrup, sugar and water, then adding gelatin dissolved in cold water and mixing it into the hot syrup. She transfers the mixture to a stand mixer and whips it on medium‑high speed until it becomes light, aerated marshmallow. She greases a pan, pours the remaining mixture into it, lets it set at room temperature for about an hour, then cuts the set marshmallows into squares or shapes, dusting them with powdered sugar and cornstarch to reduce stickiness. Using a piping bag, she pipes the fluffy marshmallow onto graham crackers, stacks the crackers to form s’mores, and dips the assembled sandwiches in melted chocolate. Finally she plates the finished s’mores and ends the video with a brief closing segment featuring a man speaking in front of a colorful vegetable graphic.
action_list: Pick up and set down object
Place bowl and attach whisk on mixer
Arrange marshmallows and butter paper on plate
